title: MMS matrix API and result surface
objective: Add a matrix-capable MMS API and local result structure without changing the existing Hex8 MMS function contract.

plan_assets.asset_description: Phase E6 generalized MMS matrix scope and non-goals.

scope: Add a new matrix-capable MMS API instead of changing run_mms_convergence.
Add convergence result structures local to the MMS/convergence module.
Define documented material policy for dissipative models.
implementation_steps: Run GitNexus impact before editing existing convergence symbols.
Add the additive MMS matrix API and result dataclasses.
Wire element-family mesh support through Phase 1 helpers.
Document elastic-regime policy for dissipative material entries if used.
Add API-focused tests that leave existing test_convergence.py unchanged.
deliverables: Policy documentation in tests or module docstrings.
acceptance_criteria: Existing run_mms_convergence(lam, mu, ...) contract remains unchanged.
MMS matrix results do not use BenchmarkResult.
Existing convergence tests remain unchanged and passing.

cases: new matrix API import and smoke run

risks: Expanding MMS by changing the existing function would break current tests; mitigate by adding a new API and leaving existing callers untouched.
completion_notes: Added an additive MMS matrix API in mechdsl.verify.mms_matrix.
Preserved the existing run_mms_convergence(lam, mu, ...) signature and return contract.
MMS matrix results use local convergence dataclasses and do not use BenchmarkResult.
Dissipative materials are explicitly documented as elastic-regime MMS policy entries.
